summary:
bent_over_row Analysis (0% form accuracy): Focus on:
- Match your left and right sides — keep both arms moving at the same height and pace.
Try:
- Set the camera exactly side-on at hip height, 2-3 meters away, with your full body always in frame.
- Pull both arms together and match left-right at the top.

issues.message: Match your left and right sides — keep both arms moving at the same height and pace.
Keep a soft bend in your knees — avoid locking out your legs during the row.
